## Overview

Enable text-only DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash P/D serving with PCP on the NIXL Prefill producer and PCP=1 on Decode.

Built on merged #59857 and stacked on #59325 and #59330. The remaining prerequisite commits are included with attribution; only the final commit, `af96945ccb`, implements this feature's model capability gate, focused tests and deployment documentation.

## Claims

- Allow GPU `NixlConnector` pull producers to use PCP with PP=DP=DCP=1 and synchronous scheduling; retain the existing model/backend restrictions and reject consumer PCP, push, bidirectional and custom connector paths.
- Reuse NIXL's canonical PCP-rank-0 transfer workers to carry compressed KV, indexer keys, the SWA tail and the compressor ring into a PCP1 decoder, including heterogeneous TP for replicated MLA caches.
- Preserve a matching N−1 handoff boundary and producer KV reclamation through the existing prerequisite fixes.

## Validation

Rebased onto main `fa75d3456d` on 2026-10-16. The GPU results below were collected at pre-rebase head `a888e22d83` and have not been rerun on rebased head `af96945ccb`. All 11 remaining patches are unchanged by `git range-diff`; post-rebase static checks pass. No tests or local CI were run for this rebase.

Target-GPU validation used one 8x NVIDIA H20 node for Prefill and one for Decode (driver `535.161.08`):

- Prefill: TP4/PCP2 on `192.168.1.186`
- Decode: TP8/PCP1 on `192.168.1.220`
- NIXL 1.5.0 pull over `mlx5_1..4`
- PR head: `a888e22d831b48873b9c5decca51154de3e6feca`
- Base image source: `77154ca6116ae34cbfe314beef1016bde9b63989`
- The base image is the PR merge base. Validation overlaid the PR's 17 runtime files from backport commit `2b40794c22` before launch.

Functional and transfer checks passed:

- Tiny completion, exact token-ID boundaries `127/128/129/4095/4096/4097`, repeated 4097, and 8192-token requests all returned HTTP 200.
- All eight Decode ranks passed the compatibility handshake. The topology reported `tp_ratio=2`, `local_tp=8`, and `remote_tp=4`.
- Across seven boundary requests, Decode recorded `+16769` external queries and `+16762` external hits. The exact N−1 relation was `16762 = 16769 - 7`.
- The same requests produced `+56 = 7 requests x 8 ranks` NIXL transfers, with zero failed transfers, failed notifications, expirations, or notifications after expiry.

Full GSM8K test-split coverage also completed:

- EvalScope 1.11.1, 1,319 examples, 0-shot, batch size 8
- `temperature=0.2`, `top_p=0.95`, seed 42, `reasoning_effort=high`, `max_tokens=256`
- Requested/succeeded/errored: `1319/1319/0`
- Accuracy: `6/1319 = 0.4549%`
- `stop_reason=max_tokens`: `1314/1319 = 99.62%`
- Mean/P99 latency: `32.324s/32.902s`
- Decode external queries/hits: `+139749/+138430`, preserving `138430 = 139749 - 1319`
- NIXL transfers: `+10552 = 1319 requests x 8 ranks`; bytes: `+32652656128` (30.41 GiB)
- Failed transfers, failed notifications, KV expirations, and new notifications after expiry: all zero
- Prefill, Decode, and Router remained Ready with restart count zero

The GSM8K score is dominated by the requested 256-token output cap: 99.62% of responses exhausted the cap before natural completion. This result qualifies bounded-output P/D transport and sustained stability, not model accuracy, and must not be compared with an uncapped or historical `max_tokens=65536` result.

<summary>Validated vLLM P/D launch parameters</summary>

Common environment:

```bash
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
export UCX_TLS=all
export UCX_NET_DEVICES=mlx5_1:1,mlx5_2:1,mlx5_3:1,mlx5_4:1
export UCX_LOG_LEVEL=warn
export UCX_RCACHE_MAX_UNRELEASED=1024
export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1
export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0
export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0
export VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=600
export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600
```

Prefill also used:

```bash
export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST=192.168.1.186
export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=5600

vllm serve /data00/models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8001 \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --language-model-only \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --attention-backend FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_ds_mla \
  --block-size 64 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --no-swa-bounded-replay \
  --enforce-eager \
  --no-async-scheduling \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --prefill-context-parallel-size 2 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend allgather_reducescatter \
  --max-model-len 131072 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --kv-transfer-config \
  '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail"}'
```

Decode also used:

```bash
export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST=192.168.1.220
export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=5600

vllm serve /data00/models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8002 \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --language-model-only \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --attention-backend FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_ds_mla \
  --block-size 64 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --no-swa-bounded-replay \
  --enforce-eager \
  --no-async-scheduling \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --prefill-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend allgather_reducescatter \
  --max-model-len 131072 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --kv-transfer-config \
  '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail"}'
```

</details>

## Details

1. P stops before the final prompt token, computes the prefix with PCP and gathers cache writes/open ratio-2 state onto equivalent replicas.
2. D reads the compressed KV, indexer keys, SWA tail and per-request compressor ring from the PCP-rank-0 replica's TP workers. Non-transferring PCP ranks retain their synthetic completion notifications.
3. D resumes at N−1, computes the final prompt token and closes any pending ratio-2 pair using the transferred ring. NIXL completion notifications release the producer's replicas.

Both sides use NVIDIA CUDA, Model Runner V2, `FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41`, the same KV dtype/block size and this revision. The initial configuration uses GPU buffers, eager execution, no prefix caching, no SWA bounded replay, no speculative decoding and no microbatching. The usage guide includes TP4/PCP2 Prefill and TP8/PCP1 Decode arguments. Both sides must keep handshake compatibility checks enabled; the inherited N−1 protocol change uses NIXL version 15 because main already assigned version 14 to the PLE metadata change.

This does not duplicate the open fixes: #59325 owns the generic replicated-PCP completion repair and #59330 owns the generic P/D endpoint change. They are reused here without a competing implementation. #58289 targets encoder-only Prefill, and #61121 optimizes packed-row transfer registration; neither enables this full-model V4.1 PCP/NIXL path. Main already includes the generic MoE padding fix from #60946.

Local CPU/static checks: `VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_pcp.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector_hma.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_desc_geometry.py -k 'pcp or dsv41_nixl_handoff or mamba_n1 or ring_scratch' --confcutdir=tests -p no:cacheprovider -q` covers 57 passing cases; `pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD` and `git diff --check origin/main` pass. Target-GPU transport and capped GSM8K stability validation are complete; uncapped model accuracy and performance validation remain TODO.

AI assistance was used for implementation, tests and drafting. The human submitter remains responsible for reviewing every changed line and completing uncapped accuracy and performance validation before marking this draft Ready.
